desc: Justify the exchange argument (K smallest as tops matched in order with K largest as bottoms) and monotonicity of feasibility in K.
Write the complete solution code (initial binary-search + numpy version).

Harden against numpy conversion failure: pure-Python two-pointer greedy is now the only path (numpy branch removed), and disjointness is enforced structurally by restricting tops to indices `[0,h)` and bottoms to `[n-h,n)` with `h=n//2` (fixes the `A=[1,2,4]` double-use bug).
Desk-check final code on samples (3, 0, 6) and edge cases: N=2 [1,2]⇒1, [1,1]⇒0, [1,2,4]⇒1, all-equal⇒0; O(N) parse + ≤N/2 loop is comfortably fast for N=5·10^5.
